en:
I won't, man.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>If</font_kind> you can beat me, that is!

Now let's get moving.
This is our last dance!
Dieee, Kazuma Kiryuuu!
Dammit, I took him too lightly.

I-I actually won!
I'm the king of the world!

Now that I've laid a whooping on <font_kind=yakuza_italic>the</font_kind> Kazuma Kiryu,
my gym empire's just a hop and a skip away!

Too bad, Kiryu-san. But I will say,
it's only 'cause of you that I got this strong.
That's why I'll let you redeem yourself.

Come back if you think you can beat me in
a rematch. I'll take you on as much as you want.

I've already planned out the fight, though.
You're gonna fail just as hard as you did this time!

Keep coming my way if you wanna die, Kiryu-san!
Just kidding!

(This is humiliating... but he <font_kind=yakuza_italic>is</font_kind> strong.
I should put my head down and try again.)

Oh, Kiryu-san!
Here for another smackdown?

I can't let this end like that.
This time, it's going to be different.

What, you <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really</font_kind> think you can beat me?
Well now's your chance to prove it!
You're dead meattt, Kiryuuu!
I lost...
You're a lot stronger, Sodachi.

Can't disagree with that.
But the legendary Kiryu's still a cut above.
I only got this strong thanks to you, man.

My admiration toward you, my desire to beat you...
Those were the best motivators a guy could ask for.

That's what helped me get through my training.
I've really gotta thank you for that.

All I did was smack you around a few times.
Your hard work is what really made you stronger.
You should be proud.

Y-You think? Yeah, you're right!
I totally gave it my all!

But no matter how much effort I put in,
my appreciation for you remains unchanged.

If there's ever anything I can do for you,
don't hesitate to give me a ring!
All right. Will do.
Who's that...?

Nah, nah, it's nothing! Just some guy
who looked like a hidden video game boss!

I'm sure it's nothing to get worked up over.
Can't judge a book by its cover, after all!
Anyways, I should be outta here.

I might've lost <font_kind=yakuza_italic>this</font_kind> time, but I'm gonna keep
training so I can get to your level, Kiryu-san.
Gimme another fight someday, yeah?
Heh... If I feel like it.
Good enough! Later!
That's enough of this!

You'll never amount to anything with that attitude.
Don't you understand?

I-I do. I just wanted to see
him one last time before I left.

How are you ever going to survive in Tokyo like this?
It's a harsh world up there.
Idol life isn't all just fun and games!
So, that girl wants to be an idol?

If you're serious about pursuing this career path,
you'll need to leave this town, and him, behind.
Idols aren't allowed to be in love.
I suggest you heed my warning.
You're trying to become an idol, right?
Sorry, I didn't mean to eavesdrop on you.

I'm such a disgrace, aren't I?
I shouldn't be crying in public like this...
Cheer up, kid. I'll see you around.

No, I really appreciate the offer.
 I think it'll help talking to someone.

Why don't you talk to me for a bit?
It'll be better for you than crying here all alone.
I don't want to force you, though.
My name is Misa.

You're from Tokyo, right, Kiryu-san?
I didn't think you'd be so... kind.

Anyone would be worried about
a girl your age crying in the street.

Anyway, feel free to tell me what's bothering you.
That was some argument you were having.

That woman from earlier is from a production firm
based up in Tokyo. She's my manager, Endo-san.
Endo seemed really upset with you for some reason.

Yeah, there's a pretty big rule I'm breaking...
Once you become an idol, dating's off-limits.
That's why she was yelling at me.
Off-limits, huh...

What happened is, I had finally had a breakout
moment in an audition, and got reassigned to Tokyo.

But, that's when I realized something: I have feelings
for an old childhood friend and senpai of mine.

Even though I was taking lessons about being an idol,
the thought of leaving him worried me to no end.
That's understandable.

He's been so supportive about me realizing my
dream, though. He was there when nobody else was.

Now that I think about it, he was the first person
I told about me moving to Tokyo after the audition, too.

Even when my parents and the other adults refused
to support me, he was there, cheering me on.
Sounds pretty special.

He is. That's why I want to make sure he knows
how I feel before I leave for Tokyo forever.

If he accepts me... I think I'm going to stay here.
I won't know his answer until I tell him, though.
I guess it's no surprise your manager is upset.
Honestly, I know it's dumb.

This is supposed to be my make-or-break moment
as an idol, but my stupid emotions are in the way...

Maybe... Maybe I should just go to Tokyo.
Can I really ignore my feelings like that...?

No matter what, you should go tell him how you feel.
At least that's what I would do.

If you don't, you'll always wonder what would
have happened if you hadn't run away.
That's how it goes.
Oh. I hadn't thought of it like that...
It's better if you don't go see him.

If you give up on your idol dream now,
all the support he gave you will have been for nothing.

But if I go to Tokyo now, who knows if
I'll ever be able to see him again...

You can either become an idol, or stay
with this guy. The choice is yours.
I-I guess you're right about that.
Why don't I help you forget about him?

A rebound is always a quick fix for a broken heart.
Older men tend to be more experienced, too.
Um... You can't be serious.

I thought you were nice for listening to me,
but now your real intentions come to light.
It was a joke.
Oh, good! Funny joke, huh?
Anyway, what are you going to do?

Um, I think I'm going to go see him.
I can't leave for Tokyo without saying how I feel.
Right. I can't say I'm surprised.

When people are troubled by something, they usually
just need to look for the answer within themselves.
Oh. So that's why you decided to talk to me.

Thank you, Kiryu-san. I feel a little bit
better now that I've talked to you.

It was nothing. Well, I should be going.
Are you going to be okay?

What's going on, Misa? Aren't you going
to tell that senpai of yours how you feel?

I tried, but I got kinda nervous...
Sorry, but can you give me some more time?
Sure. I wasn't trying to rush you.

Hm? Is that... Misa? So the guy
must be the one she mentioned earlier.

Um, well, there's something
I really need to talk to you about!
What's going on, Misa? I'm all ears.

Um, do you remember how I told you my dream
of becoming an idol back in middle school, senpai?
Yeah, of course I do.

It was after you saw Haruka Sawamura's
last concert on TV. That was what inspired you.

So Misa wants to be an idol now
because of Haruka...?

Back then, everyone made fun of me and
called me names. You were different, though.
You've supported me nonstop since then.
The truth is, um... from that day forward, I...

It would be rude of me to keep listening to this.
I should get out of here before they notice me.

Well, well! Look what we got here!
Y'guys're real cute, y'know?

This ain't no place t'be gettin'
all lovey-dovey like that, though.
U-Uh, excuse me?
Hey, we're in the middle of something! Go away!

Y'really got the balls t'be tellin' us off?
Don't y'know yer in a public place? Huh!?
It looks like I might need to get involved.

Hey bro, we don't got business with ya.
We're way more into this li'l lady over here.

'At's right! Yer in our way, brat! Y'better get
lost before we gotta lay the beatdown on ya.
Okay! Please don't hurt me...!
Huh? S-Senpai?
(Some senpai he is.)
Look, Misa. These guys probably aren't so bad, right?

Plus, I've got entrance exams coming up.
I can't be getting hurt now.
W-Wait, what...?
I'm really sorry!
Senpai! Please, don't leave me!

Jus' forget about him, li'l lady.
Yer boyfriend abandoned ya here, right?
How 'bout y'have some fun with us instead?

I said, no! You guys are
nothing but a bunch of thugs!
Huh? What're y'lookin' at, gramps?

This ain't any o' yer business!
Get lost, ya old fuck!

This actually isn't any of <font_kind=yakuza_italic>your</font_kind> business.
You interrupted a tender moment here.

If you want to lay your hands on the girl,
you're going to have to go through me.
Who the hell's this shit?

Ugh, whatever. We're gonna make ya
regret gettin' in our way! C'mon!

H-Hold on a sec, old man! Look,
we're only doin' this 'cause someone asked us!

I think that's enough.
You've served your purpose.
Endo-san? Wait, what's going on?
That woman... She's Misa's manager, right?

I'm the one who hired these men. I wanted
to test how devoted your senpai is to you, Misa.

As I expected, he instead showed us the true cowardice
in his heart. Has that cured your lovesickness, Misa?

I haven't actually started packing for Tokyo yet.
I should probably go do that, huh...
Yes. It's for the best.
Misa!
You've done quite enough already... Kazuma Kiryu-san.
What? You know who I am?

Everyone in the industry knows that face of yours.
You're the yakuza who forced Haruka into retirement.

I don't care why you're down here in Onomichi,
but I need you to stop trying to help Misa.

Her conscience needs to be clear when she
heads up to Tokyo. Isn't that right, senpai?
What? I don't get it. You were in on this scheme, too?

Yes. I'm actually the one who came up
with the idea to begin with.

Those other guys are classmates of mine.
All Endo-san did was agree to follow along.
Man, y'really put us through the ringer.

Sorry about that, you guys. I'll buy you
dinner to make up for it, okay?
Sure, sure. See ya later.
Care to explain what's going on here?

I don't know if this is much of an explanation,
but I've been there for Misa every step of the way.

I know just how hard she's had to work
to get to where she is today.

That's why... That's why she needs to focus on
being an idol instead of confessing to a chump like me.

He's had feelings for Misa for many years now.
Since far before she realized how she felt.

So this was all for Misa, then.
That's why you're pulling yourself away from her.

If I stop her from pursuing her dream of stardom,
I'd never be able to forgive myself.

Even if Misa and I ended up together,
I'm sure that would always weigh heavy on my mind.

You know, when Endo-san told me the other day how
Misa felt about me, I was honestly over the moon.

But that's exactly why I didn't think I'd be able to trick
her like this. I can't stand the thought of hurting her.
So this was all for her sake...

If Misa abandons her feelings for me, she'll be able to
push onward toward her dream without any regrets.

Honestly, I don't care how she thinks of me now.
I'd do whatever it takes for her.

Even for someone you love,
that's not an easy path to walk.
Kiryu-san, was it?

If you ever see Misa around town,
could you not tell her about this?

To be perfectly honest, I'd much rather
let her know what's going on.

But I'm just an outsider. It's not
really my place to say anything.
Thank you so much. Goodbye, then.

I appreciate this, Kiryu-san.
Let me show my gratitude.
Is this supposed to keep me quiet?
It's a simple thank-you gift.

You know, even though you're a famous yakuza,
you actually turned out to be quite understanding.

Huh. You're kinder than you look, too.
Anyway, take good care of Misa.

Speaking of which, where did Misa run off to?
She seemed pretty shocked earlier.
Misa? How long have you been there?
I... I didn't hear anything, promise!
Then why did you run away?

I know you're probably confused after hearing all that.
I'm sure it's hard to know everyone is deceiving you.
But I need you to listen.

Pretend like you didn't hear any of that. Go to Tokyo,
and succeed. That's what Endo and your senpai want.
So you're taking their side, Kiryu-san.
I guess I am.

You should be a track star instead of an idol.
It's damn impressive how fast you can run.

Plus if you did that, there wouldn't be
any problem with you dating your senpai.
That's a dumb joke...
Love is more important than entertainment.

That senpai you admire so much is a great guy.
People aren't really like that up in Tokyo.
But if I stay here, do you think he'll really be happy?

You heard what he was saying earlier, Kiryu-san.
He'd regret holding me back from my dream.

If I want to keep him happy and in love with me,
leaving for Tokyo is my only option.
